def state():
    a = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
    def bbox(col):
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(1,63) for c in range(0,63) if a[r][c]==col]

    return bbox('B'), bbox('c'), bbox('Y')
for i in range(6):
    action(['DOWN'])
    print('after DOWN', i+1, ':', state())

        print('COMPLETED'); break
